attackers_goals: Exfiltrate data from the cloud environment.
description: An identity initiated a download of multiple cloud objects. This might be an indication for an adversary trying to exfiltrate data from cloud storage.
investigative_actions: Check the identity which invoked the operations. Check the accessed resource and verify it doesn't contain sensitive data.
name: An identity initiated a download of multiple cloud objects
